            await reset_dut(dut)
            await bus_write(dut, 3, 0x00)
            control = 0xC0 | (cpol << 3) | (cpha << 2)
            await bus_write(dut, 0, control)

            tx = 0xA6 ^ (cpol * 0xFF) ^ (cpha * 0x3C)
            rx = 0x96 ^ (cpol * 0x55) ^ (cpha * 0xA0)
            await bus_write(dut, 2, tx)

            sck = cpol if cpha == 0 else 1 - cpol
            assert int(dut.sck_o.value) == sck
            assert int(dut.mosi_o.value) == ((tx >> 7) & 1)

            # the read FIFO. SPIF is set on the following edge.

            await tick(dut)
            assert int(dut.inta_o.value) == 0

            _, status = await bus_read(dut, 1)
            assert status == 0x85  # SPIF, write FIFO empty, read FIFO nonempty
            assert int(dut.inta_o.value) == 1

            # Reading address 2 returns and removes the oldest received byte.
            first_data, second_data = await bus_read(dut, 2)
            assert first_data == rx
            assert second_data == rx

            # A write of bit 7 clears SPIF; the interrupt follows the
            # registered SPIF value.
            await bus_write(dut, 1, 0x80)
            assert int(dut.inta_o.value) == 0
            _, status = await bus_read(dut, 1)
            assert status == 0x05

    await bus_write(dut, 3, 0x00)
    await bus_write(dut, 0, 0x40 | 0x03)  # SPE, SPR=3
    await bus_write(dut, 2, 0x5A)

    await tick(dut)  # load byte
    previous_sck = int(dut.sck_o.value)
    transition_cycles = []
    for cycle in range(1, 300):
        dut.miso_i.value = 1
        await tick(dut)
        current_sck = int(dut.sck_o.value)
        if current_sck != previous_sck:
            transition_cycles.append(cycle)
            previous_sck = current_sck
        if len(transition_cycles) == 16:
            break

    assert len(transition_cycles) == 16
    for index in range(1, len(transition_cycles)):
        assert transition_cycles[index] - transition_cycles[index - 1] == 16

    # The long divider keeps the engine occupied while the write FIFO is
    # filled. ESPR=11 selects N=2047.
    await reset_dut(dut)
    await bus_write(dut, 3, 0x02)
    await bus_write(dut, 0, 0x40 | 0x03)
    await bus_write(dut, 2, 0x11)
    await tick(dut)  # engine loads the first byte
    await tick(dut)  # first byte is popped from the write FIFO

    for value in (0x22, 0x33, 0x44, 0x55, 0x66):
        await bus_write(dut, 2, value)

    _, status = await bus_read(dut, 1)
    assert status == 0x49  # WCOL, write FIFO full, read FIFO empty

    await bus_write(dut, 1, 0x40)
    _, status = await bus_read(dut, 1)
    assert status == 0x09  # WCOL cleared; full and empty flags unchanged
